style.styleTitle: Lights4fun Chirstmas 2m Pre Lit Autumn Winter Garland
style.toneOfVoice: <p>Celebrate all the shades of the season with this Pre Lit Autumn Winter Garland. A natural twig frame supports a gorgeous display of wintery faux foliage in rich tones of plum, ochre and shades of deep green.</p><p>A total of 50 warm white LEDs are scattered through the greenery to give the garland a lovely cosy glow.The foliage of this garland matches the Autumn Winter Trio Candle Holder and Autumn Winter Pre Lit Bough, so there’s plenty of scope for versatile styling here. </p><p>Swag the garland along a mantlepiece or over a large mirror in the living room or pin it up around an interior door to bring the vivid colours of autumn and winter inside.</p>
style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted: Celebrate all the shades of the season with this Pre-Lit Autumn-Winter Garland. A natural twig frame supports a gorgeous display of wintery faux foliage in rich tones of plum, ochre, and shades of deep green. A total of 50 warm white LEDs are scattered through the greenery to give the garland a lovely, cosy glow. The foliage of this garland matches the Autumn Winter Trio Candle Holder and Autumn Winter Pre-Lit Bough, so there’s plenty of scope for versatile styling here. Swag the garland along a mantlepiece or over a large mirror in the living room, or pin it up around an interior door to bring the vivid colours of autumn and winter inside.
